Torrezx-Demon Ascarel

Español

Este set infernal viene a darte un toque mas ferroz a la hora de combatir o realizar acciones como minar

La union de dos almas demoniacas lograron formar a este equipamiento denominado Ascarel.ahora 

busca saciar su hambre de pelea !

Este set de herramientas reemplazan a todos las herramientas de netherite

English

This infernal set comes to give you a fiercer touch when fighting or performing actions such as mining

The union of two demonic souls managed to form this equipment called Ascarel.now

seeks to satisfy his hunger for a fight!

This set of tools replaces all netherite tools

 

No requiere de optifine/Not optifine 

Sigueme / Follow me :D !!!
